headline: HikariCP pool exhausted: {N} threads parked in getConnection
detail: Multiple threads are stuck inside com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool.getConnection, parked on the ConcurrentBag condition. The pool has no idle connections; every requester waits until one is returned or the connectionTimeout fires. This is almost never a sizing problem — almost always a connection-leak (forgot try-with-resources) or a downstream-DB-stall problem.
remediation: First, find a thread that owns a connection right now (look at threads inside JDBC reads / Statement.execute that AREN'T inside HikariPool.getConnection). If those are stuck on a network read, the database itself is the bottleneck and increasing the pool won't help. If you can't find an owner, you have a leak — enable leakDetectionThreshold in HikariCP config to surface where connections are checked out and never returned.
